scope: All existing over hypotheses, compatible original pocket entries, archived policies and historical seed; no newly optimized thresholds. Paused histories retained for survivorship audit, not reactivated.
confirmation: Previously inspected history is exploratory. No retrospective temporal split is an untouched confirmatory holdout.
mature_day_rule: Exclude latest Moscow calendar day from primary selection screen; retain partial day and pending entries visibly.
research_candidate_requires: positive mature ROI and positive full available ROI
positive ROI excluding three best results
positive ROI excluding best profit day
positive ROI excluding best profit league
positive early and late chronological halves of mature entry days
at least two nonempty fixed temporal blocks and positive ROI in every nonempty block
positive mature profit even under a minus-one-unit sensitivity bound for unresolved mature entries
uncertainty: Student t mean interval with maximum of iid, day-cluster, league-cluster, and two-way day/league variance. Few-day results remain exploratory. Holm adjustment across all evaluated cohorts is descriptive; the complete adaptive historical search count is unknown, with a documented lower bound of 37099.
multiplicity: Retain all tested groups including losses and duplicate/overlapping hypotheses. Do not add Ns across groups.
future_validation: Freeze the resulting research list; no rule or threshold tuning within its next prospective cohort. No automatic task is created.
production_promotion: Requires an untouched prospective test, predeclared review or valid sequential test, multiplicity control and validation of the actual executable manual LIVE portfolio. Historical research priority does not qualify for betting.
